title: US Buyers: RFQ Checklist Before Sourcing Paper Tube Packaging from an Overseas Source Factory
description: A buyer-question bridge for United States buyers preparing RFQ details before sourcing custom paper tube packaging from an overseas source factory.
buyerQuestion: What should United States buyers prepare before requesting a custom paper tube packaging quote from an overseas source factory?
shortAnswer: US buyers should prepare product dimensions, product weight, target category, cap or closure direction, artwork status, surface finish preference, packing method and destination-market document requests before asking for quotation or sampling discussion. This helps the supplier review fit and structure without over-specifying unsupported details.
localRoute: The project needs domestic stock, local fulfillment or local supplier paperwork.
The buyer needs a domestic route for internal purchasing or distribution reasons.
The project is not yet ready for custom structure, artwork or finish review.
The buyer needs local sampling logistics before comparing overseas production options.
sourceFactoryRoute: The buyer needs custom paper tube structure, diameter, height, cap style or insert review.
The project needs cosmetic, candle, tea, fragrance, wellness or premium retail packaging development.
The buyer has artwork direction, finish references and product details ready for review.
The buyer wants to compare structure and presentation rather than only local stock availability.

rfqDetails: Product type and target sales channel
Product dimensions, weight and product photos
Preferred tube diameter, height and cap style if known
Artwork status, color direction and finish reference
Surface finish direction such as matte, glossy, foil, embossing, label or texture
Packing method, carton packing expectation and destination market
Any document request that must be reviewed case by case before use
